39:41.text: Verily, We have sent down to you
for mankind in truth. So whosoever accepts the guidance, it is only for his ownself, and whosoever goes astray, he goes astray only for his
(trustee or disposer of affairs, or guardian)

39:42.text: It is Allâh Who takes away the souls at the time of their death, and those that die not during their sleep. He keeps those
for which He has ordained death and sends the rest for a term appointed. Verily, in this are signs for a people who think deeply.

39:43.text: as intercessors besides Allâh? Say: "Even if they have power over nothing whatever and have no intelligence?"

39:44.text: Say: "To Allâh belongs all intercession. His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you shall be brought back."

39:45.text: And when Allâh Alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter are filled with disgust
(from the Oneness of Allâh توحيد الله)
[like all false deities other than Allâh, - it may be a Messenger, an angel, a pious man, a jinni, or any other creature even idols, graves of religious people, saints, priests, monks and others.]

39:46.text: : "O Allâh! Creator of the heavens and the earth! All-Knower of the Ghaib
and the seen! You will judge between your slaves about that wherein they used to differ."

39:47.text: (the polytheists and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh)

, if they had all that is in earth and therewith as much again, they verily, would offer it to ransom themselves therewith on the Day of Resurrection from the evil torment; and there will become apparent to them from Allâh what they had not been reckoning.
